news.title: IDP to consolidate 15 India student placement locations
news.summary_en: Around 200 employees are understood to be affected as the international education company responds to falling student volumes and shifting visa policies across major study destinations.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: The PIEoneer Awards 2026: winners revealed
news.summary_en: Innovation and achievement across the international education sector has once again been recognised at The PIEoneer Awards ceremony, now in its 10th year.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: BCA season: UKVI is checking its list, we’re checking ours twice
news.summary_en: It’s the most wonderful time of the year. UKVI is checking its list, sponsors are checking theirs twice, we're going to find out who's naughty or nice... but the slight difficulty is that the lack of timely data means the lists won't necessarily match up when it comes to the BCA.
news.author: Alex Lock and Mike Strong

news.title: Crizac profit jumps 41% as revenue rises 23%
news.summary_en: The Indian recruitment platform processed 394,000 applications during 2025/26, although the UK continued to generate approximately 97% of its revenue.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Lincoln Bishop University set to join Global University Systems
news.summary_en: Global University Systems (GUS) has announced plans to take ownership of Lincoln Bishop University, in a move it says will strengthen the university’s “local, national and international impact” and ensure its long-term financial sustainability.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Cormack Consultancy Group launches partnership intelligence service
news.summary_en: Cormack Consultancy Group (CCG) has launched Collaborizer, a new service designed to help universities identify and prioritise international research and transnational education (TNE) partnership opportunities.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: “Don’t put all your eggs in one basket”: US visa rejections push Gambian student to Japan
news.summary_en: The PIE News speaks to Gambian student Adama Jarju about turning to Japan after years of US visa rejections, and why he hasn’t looked back.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: International students prove a fiscal win for the Netherlands, CPB finds
news.summary_en: International students are a net positive for the Dutch government’s finances over their lifetimes, despite the costs of educating them, according to a new report from the Dutch Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB).
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Rubio’s student visa revocations ruled “retaliatory”
news.summary_en: Stanford University’s student newspaper has won a legal challenge over the US State Department, whose F-1 visa revocations and deportations of students expressing pro-Palestine views have been ruled illegal.
news.author: Polly Nash
